risks.title: Requirements split below the quotation threshold
risks.risk: Related payments to one supplier may together exceed a threshold that each single payment stays under, so the quotation and notice requirements of [rule:CPR-54] may not be applied ([rule:CPR-12]).

likelihood.justification: {{$.tests.split_purchases.by_threshold.25000.headline_general_procurement.windows}} supplier windows in general procurement combine to cross the threshold [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.by_threshold.25000.headline_general_procurement].

uplift.justification: The contract-letting follow-up [history:AUD-90] covered quotation evidence for awards below the tender threshold.

impact.justification: The flagged windows total {{$.tests.split_purchases.by_threshold.25000.headline_general_procurement.gbp}} in the period [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.by_threshold.25000.headline_general_procurement.gbp].

evidence: Placements are shown separately ({{$.tests.split_purchases.by_threshold.25000.placement_separately.windows}} windows) because [rule:CPR-63] exempts them from competition.
risks.proposed_focus: Test the largest general-procurement windows for a single underlying requirement and the quotation evidence required by [rule:CPR-54].

risks.title: Spend above the award value without an approved variation
risks.risk: Annualised spend with some suppliers is well above the annual rate of their published award, which may indicate a variation without the approval [rule:CPR-62] requires.

impact.justification: Roughly £2.9m a year is above the award rates.

risks.proposed_focus: Request the variation approvals for the flagged notices.
